VERIFIED: (1) every effect-level member of .7 (S1.01-S1.15, S1.19, S5.06, S6.01, S6.06 and the S2/S4 effect parts) and of .2/.4/.6 is now EXACT against the printed text or ABSENT with a verbatim span (manual/tome x6, goat aura, Nine Lives slain-only charge loss); read each against its sentence - no residual disagreement in those members. (3) Span mechanism sound and drift-proof: magicItemAdjudicatedEffects.ts fails loudly on non-verbatim span / unknown effect / missing effects-block clause / still-present dropped field; magicItemCompiler.ts:708-725 throws unless adjudicated sourceText is a non-empty verbatim substring of the record description; kindSchemas.ts:6092-6100 requires non-empty sourceText; test asserts the substring over every adjudicated clause (11). (4) Removals break no consumer: no src reference to the removed ids/chargeCost; no operation referenced the withheld effects; readiness 3->11 adjudicated, green 218->212 are the six study rewards; use_item green operations unchanged; runtime item tests green. (5) Edited expectations are source-backed (backlog 795->794 + fingerprint = goat candidate only, engine-pending 794->793; figurine DC 15 conservation exception names the adjudicated span; goat 'riding' assertion replaced by the absent-row check, not weakened). (6) Registry magic-item-effects names eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 and bounds scope to mechanics.effects, but its claim that each structured effect agrees with the printed text is untrue at this head because of S1-S3 below.
FINDINGS (all mechanics.effects members, so in this PR's scope; invariant for each = faithful-or-absent: a typed effect states the printed predicate exactly or is absent with a verbatim span; registry row magic-item-effects source-agreement claim).
S1 - BLOCKING: both alignment talismans drop the SPELL-ATTACK scope of their +2 bonus. magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:928-946 (bonus(... 'attackRollModifier', 2, '<good|evil> cleric or paladin wearing or holding the talisman')); records.json:138516 (c2-static-pure-good-spell-attacks) and c2-static-ultimate-evil-spell-attacks. Printed: 'If you are a good [evil] cleric or paladin, you can use the talisman as a holy symbol, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.' Emitted: attackRollModifier amount 2 whose only appliesTo is the eligibility/possession text; no spell-attack scope anywhere in the effect. Every sibling attackRollModifier carries its roll scope in appliesTo (Staff of Power/Magi/Woodlands, Robe of the Archmagi 'spell attacks'; Wand of the War Mage 'spell attack rolls while holding this wand'), so the vocabulary can carry it. Scenario: a good paladin wearing the Talisman of Pure Good makes a longsword WEAPON attack - the emitted effect applies +2; the printed item grants nothing. The .5 repair (wearing -> wearing or holding) touched this exact field and the registry lists both talismans as repaired. Closure: appliesTo states 'spell attack rolls' and the class/alignment + wear-or-hold predicate moves to a condition (or the effect becomes absent with a verbatim span); add EXACT rows asserting 'spell attack rolls' for both.
S2 - BLOCKING: Ring of Elemental Command projects all 16 plane-specific spell grants as PARENT effects, without the linked-plane or help-slay predicate. magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:567-608; records.json:118631 (c2-dominate-air-elemental), :118638 (c2-cast-chain-lightning) etc. Printed: each variant may 'expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on an [air|earth|fire|water] elemental', and the further spells (chain lightning/gust of wind/wind wall; stone shape/stoneskin/wall of stone; burning hands/fireball/wall of fire; create or destroy water/control water/ice storm/wall of ice) only 'If you help slay an [X] elemental while attuned to the ring'. Emitted: every castSpell sits in parent mechanics.effects (effective for every variant), none carries a plane or slay condition; the variants' own mechanics.effects already exist and their passives carry the slay condition (c2-static-elemental-ring-air-lightning 'after helping slay an air elemental while attuned'), so parent vs variant permissions are expressible. Scenarios: a Ring of Fire Elemental Command carries c2-dominate-air-elemental and c2-cast-chain-lightning; a Ring of Air Elemental Command whose wearer has slain nothing carries chain lightning/wind wall. Not found by any prior review (the .5 sweep claimed parent-vs-variant permissions). Closure: move each castSpell into its variant's mechanics.effects, with the help-slay-while-attuned condition on the unlockable spells (dominate stays unconditioned within its variant), or withhold as adjudicated with verbatim spans; update only operation effect references (operation activation/prerequisites stay with eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6).
S3 - BLOCKING: Dimensional Shackles typed effect is an unconditional, subject-less IMMUNITY instead of the printed restriction on the bound creature. magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:866-874; records.json:97926 (c2-residual-dimensional-movement-block, touched by .5 for the portal exception). Printed: 'the shackles prevent a creature bound by them from using any method of extradimensional movement, including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence. They don't prevent the creature from passing through an interdimensional portal.' Emitted: {kind: immunity, to: 'extradimensional movement', examples, exceptions} - no subject and no bound predicate (contrast Berserker Axe movementRestriction subject 'cursed bearer', and every effect on a non-user creature naming its targets), and 'immunity to' (cannot be affected by) is a different modality from 'prevented from using'. Scenario: the captor who places the shackles on an incapacitated creature carries an item effect making HIM immune to extradimensional movement (e.g. to his ally's teleport), while the printed effect binds only the shackled creature and only its own use of such movement. Closure: a restriction effect whose subject/condition is the creature bound by the shackles and whose predicate is using any method of extradimensional movement (portal exception kept), or absent with the verbatim span.
Registry consequence (not a separate finding): finding-registry.json magic-item-effects statusReasoning must not assert source agreement for the talismans/elemental ring/shackles until S1-S3 close.
NEW non-effect note for eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (not a finding here): Ring of Elemental Command cast/dominate operations carry an invented activation cost 'action' (printed only 'You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast ...' / 'expending the necessary number of charges') and no linked-plane/slay prerequisite; unlock-linked-plane is bound to none of them.
NO REQUIREMENT (one line each): Wings of Flying speed condition 'for 1 hour or until the command word is repeated' is undefined-state shorthand of the kind .7 accepted (Boots of Speed 'boots active', Cloak of Displacement), not a contrary predicate; the source-agreement test's EXACT table is per-member rather than a generalized mechanism - the user did not adopt the contract layer and the table is source-backed; Potion of Mind Reading concentrationRequired true restates the spell's own rule; static held benefits on staffs/weapons/shields are supplied by the wearing-and-wielding rule (.7 NOT A FINDING).
VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED (3)
